dt-example.title: Predefined states
dt-example.info:
For complex data you might wish to help your end users out by pre-populating a set of states that they can either use as a template, or will be a common route into your table's data. This can be done with the `-init stateRestore.predefined` option. It is an array that lists the states you want to provide.
It is worth noting that an end user cannot remove or edit a predefined state, but they can by default, duplicate it to then modify as they require.
This example demonstrates three simple states that will populate the states.
